'''Pedar Solardo''' was a [[human]] who served in the [[Bespin Wing Guard]] of [[Cloud City]] on the [[planet]] [[Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[3 ABY]], he was part of a [[squad]] of guards who ambushed a group of Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s and [[Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil]] as they escorted the [[Prisoner|captive]] rebels [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO]] through the [[city]]. [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], the [[Baron Administrator]] of Cloud City, congratulated the guards and had Solardo and the others take the captive Imperials to the [[Cloud City Security Tower]].

==Biography==
Pedar Solardo was a [[human]] member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard]],<ref name="Topps" /> the security and [[law enforcement agency]] of the [[mining]] platform [[Cloud City]] on the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]].<ref name="HC61">{{HelmetCollectionCite|61|Weapons & Uniforms}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]], Solardo served under<ref name="ESB" /> [[Baron Administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and his administrative assistant [[Lobot]].<ref name="HC61" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{Film|V}}</ref> [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived on Cloud City and forced Calrissian into making a deal in which he would help Vader capture a group of rebels who were soon to arrive on Bespin.<ref name="ESB" />

In order to keep the [[city]] free from Imperial control, Calrissian led the rebels into Vader's trap and they were taken captive; however, Vader began altering the deal and ordered that the rebels [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO]] be taken to his [[ST 321|shuttle]], ignoring his original promise to leave Organa in Calrissian's custody.<ref name="ESB" /> Forced into action by the change, Calrissian accompanied the [[Imperial officer]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}}</ref> and a group of four [[stormtrooper]]s as they escorted the trio of prisoners through Cloud City's corridors, but secretly contacted Lobot during the journey.<ref name="ESB" />

Lobot then led<ref name="ESB" /> a [[squad]]<ref name="Topps" /> of the guards including Solardo to intercept and ambush the Imperials, doing so at a corridor intersection. Solardo drew his [[Relby-k23 blaster pistol]] and aimed it at Sheckil, grabbing the [[officer]] once the surrounded Imperials surrendered and pulling him away from the prisoners. Calrissian congratulated the squad and ordered them to quietly take the captive Imperials to Cloud City's [[Cloud City Security Tower|security tower]] and hold them there. The Baron Administrator then left with the rebels as the security personnel marched the Imperials away<ref name="ESB" /> and placed them in a holding cell.<ref name="SYWtbaJ">''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]''</ref> Calrissian soon called for an evacuation of Cloud City over the platform's speaker system, warning the residents that the platform was now under the Empire's control before fleeing offworld himself.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Solardo had light skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Solardo wore the gold-trimmed blue [[Clothing|uniform]] of the Wing Guard, including a [[Hat|cap]], red bracers, and a black [[holster]] for his Relby K-23 blaster pistol.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pedar Solardo first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], he was first identified on a card in the [[2025]] [[Topps]] card set [[2024 Topps Star Wars Hyperspace|2024 Topps ''Star Wars'' Hyperspace]].<ref name="Topps" /> The named originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where [[Pedar Solardo/Legends|Solardo]] was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards"]], an article written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and [[Sander de Lange]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> ''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'', a [[2015]] adaptation of Episode V written by [[Adam Gidwitz]], erroneously describes the Wings Guards that free Organa, Chewbacca, and C-3PO as a [[platoon]] who were already traveling with Calrissian and the Imperials rather than arriving with Lobot,<ref name="SYWtbaJ" /> contradicting the events of the film.<ref name="ESB" />
